questions.question:
[지문]
Hi, my name is Chen and I live in Sichuan, China. People in Sichuan love hot and spicy food. I also like spicy food, and my comfort food is malatang, a hot and spicy dish that is served in a hot pot. It is usually eaten with vegetables and meat sticks. When my friends and I have a bad day at school and are stressed out, we often go to our favorite shop near school to eat malatang. We had an exam one day and we didn't do well on it. On this day, we went there and ate malatang. I put extra hot sauce in the malatang so that _________________(A)_________________. The spicy soup almost made us cry, but we enjoyed it. It made all our stress go away on that day.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 malatang은 'vegetables and meat sticks'와 함께 먹는다고 명시되어 있으며, fish(생선)에 대한 언급은 없습니다.

빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 가장 적절한 말은?
questions.explanation: Chen이 'extra hot sauce'를 넣은 목적은 마라탕의 맛을 더 맵게 하기 위한 것입니다. 다음 문장에서 'The spicy soup almost made us cry'라고 했으므로, 맵기를 더 강하게 하려는 의도를 나타내는 'it would taste hotter than usual'이 가장 적절합니다.

ⓔ Jane sat on the bench and watched the leaves to fall. (X) - watch + 목적어 + 동사원형 → watched the leaves fall
정답: ⓒ, ⓓ

questions.question:

Recipe: Orange Madeleines
(1) Melt the butter and let it cool.

다음 레시피에서 (C)에 들어갈 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation:
레시피의 논리적 순서:
(1) Melt the butter and let it cool. (버터를 녹이고 식히기)
(2) Beat eggs, sugar, and salt in a bowl. (계란, 설탕, 소금을 섞기)
(3) Combine flour in the bowl and mix. (가루를 섞기)
(4) Mix in butter and orange peel to the mixture altogether. (버터와 오렌지 껍질 섞기)
(5) Pour all the mixture into the madeleine pan. (틀에 붓기)
(6) Place the pan in the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes. (굽기)
따라서 (C)에는 버터와 오렌지 필을 섞는 단계가 와야 함

options: when I feel blue and lonely, I eat chicken soup

when I feel starving and low on energy, I call my father

questions.question:
[지문]
My comfort food is chicken soup. In the USA, people eat this soup when they have a cold. When I was a small child, I caught a very bad cold. My father made me a bowl of chicken soup so that I could get well. The hot soup warmed my body, and I slowly started to feel better. It was also very tasty. That's why these days, __________________.

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation:
지문의 맥락: "When I was a small child, I caught a very bad cold. My father made me a bowl of chicken soup so that I could get well... That's why these days..."
→ 어렸을 때 감기에 걸렸을 때 chicken soup을 먹어서 낫게 되었으므로, 요즘에도 감기에 걸렸을 때 chicken soup을 먹는다는 내용이 논리적으로 적절함
⑤ "whenever I catch a cold and feel sick, I always eat chicken soup"이 가장 일관성 있는 답
